title: Chapter 135
text:
Stardragon and Hesla's fleets had formed a tight blockade around the Tedramira River's tributary, and there were many mines on the riverbed at the estuary.

The whereabouts of the Germinal Organization's retreating troops were known by the two countries. Stardragon and Hesla viewed this battle as a great opportunity to kill the Germinal Organization.

The trap had been set. In the eyes of the two countries, the Germinal Organization was like a wild beast with nowhere to run. Even if they knew that there was a hunter's trap ahead, they had no choice but to charge headlong into it.

The battlefield was divided into two parts. The two countries were responsible for different areas. Hesla was mainly responsible for blocking the sea route, while Stardragon was responsible for intercepting the enemy on the ground. This method of cooperation helped to share the responsibility and avoid conflict of command.

Considering the individual combat power of the Germinal Organization's executive officers, Division 13 also sent secret service agents as emergency teams and assault troops with special tactical missions. They were on standby at a small dock near the estuary and listened to the military commander's orders.

Zhang Wei's team was among them.

A row of assault boats were neatly docked at the dock, and green military tents were hidden in the small forest behind the dock.

In two months, the team had not changed much. Zhang Wei was still serious, Li Ya Lin was still sexy, Lin Yao was still angry, and Lambert was still as quiet as a rock.

The only change was that there was a new, young face.

"Hou Yue, you have been in the team for a month. You have trained well. This mission is very important. Don't make any mistakes."

In the team tent, Zhang Wei instructed the newcomer, Hou Yue.

Hou Yue was a thin young man with two guns at his waist. He had long hair and was quite handsome. He nodded and smiled proudly. "Captain, you think too much. In the past month, when have I not completed a mission perfectly?"

Zhang Wei nodded. Hou Yue was an agent trained by Division 13. He had replaced Han Xiao and joined the team. His performance had been good, so Zhang Wei was not worried.

Li Ya Lin crossed her arms in front of her chest and sat at the side with her legs crossed. She was frowning and seemed to be in a bad mood.

In fact, she had not been in a good mood since Han Xiao ran away and the agents who had lost their deposits came to ask for money.

Hou Yue came over and sat beside Li Ya Lin. He smiled and said, "Beauty Li, what are you thinking?"

Li Ya Lin glared at him. "Are you a curious baby? What does it have to do with you?"

Hou Yue didn't give up and tried to get close to Li Ya Lin. When he first saw Li Ya Lin on the day he joined the team, he was stunned. It was pleasing to have a beauty as a teammate, so he tried to strike up a conversation with Li Ya Lin. However, Li Ya Lin, who was tricked by Han Xiao, suffered from the "Newcomer Syndrome". Whenever she saw Hou Yue, she would think of Han Xiao. Naturally, she didn't have a good expression.

Li Ya Lin was annoyed by his noise and suddenly revealed a dangerous smile. "You like to talk a lot?"

As he spoke, he clenched his fists, causing the bones in his hands to crackle and yellow flames to rise. The anger in his heart was all contained in the strength of his clenched fists.

Hou Yue stepped back out of reflex. He knew that once Li Ya Lin showed this kind of expression, it meant that she was going to beat him up. When he first joined the team, he suffered a loss and was bedridden in the medical department for three days.

Lin Yao, who was watching the show from the side, shook his head and pretended to be mature. "Little Monkey, you are still too cowardly. I only respect Brother Xiao when it comes to guts."

"Who is Brother Xiao?"

Hou Yue was puzzled. Ever since he joined the team, he learned that the full strength of the team was six people, but there was still one person missing. Logically speaking, the names of the members who were not in the team would be crossed out, but the sixth person in the team was always empty.

Moreover, from time to time, Hou Yue would hear Zhang Wei and the others mention Brother Xiao. Hou Yue was very curious about this sixth person.

Li Ya Lin was furious. "Don't mention his name in front of me!" she said angrily.

"We are on a mission. You can't beat me up!" Lin Yao looked calm, but his legs were shaking.

Hou Yue felt that Li Ya Lin's reaction was a bit too extreme. In his experience, this was the reaction of a resentful woman when she heard the name of the man who abandoned her … Well, it seemed that a person with a huge debt would have this kind of reaction.

Zhang Wei shook his head, sighed, and explained, "Han Xiao was originally a member of our team, but he left the team for some special reasons."

"Special reasons?" Hou Yue used his imagination and asked tentatively, "Was he sent to carry out a secret mission?"

Zhang Wei shook his head.

"Was he transferred to another unit by the higher-ups?"

Zhang Wei shook his head.

"Then where did he go?" Hou Yue was puzzled.

"Who knows? I'm 80% sure he's dead," Li Ya Lin said unhappily.

Hou Yue was skeptical.

"Who are you kidding? If he's really dead, why would there be a position for him? You guys say that you hate him, but why do I feel like you guys miss him so much …"

There was silence.

After a long time, Li Ya Lin stood up and smiled.

"Choose a way to die."

Hou Yue ran away as fast as he could.

Lambert shook his head and put away the sword that he had secretly unsheathed.

…

Stardragon's ground troops were lying in ambush in the valley near the estuary. Their goal was to intercept the Germinal Organization's ground troops. Sleepy Winter, Twinkle Fried Rice, and Rainy Kim were acting as logisticians.

The three of them had joined the Stardragon army during the closed beta and had already exchanged for their main classes. Twinkle Fried Rice and Rainy Kim were Pugilists, while Sleepy Winter was lucky enough to awaken his Esper ability with the geno fluid from the shop.

As new recruits, the three of them were also recruited to be logisticians in this war. What made the three of them overjoyed was that they had actually triggered a faction series mission — [Battle of the Tedramira River].

After the surprise, the three of them were soon troubled. The series mission had more than a dozen objectives, and they could only complete the simplest logistical objectives with the lowest rewards. The other missions, such as killing ten Germinal Organization soldiers, killing the Germinal Organization executive officers, and destroying vehicles, were completely beyond their capabilities.

"This doesn't seem like a mission that should be triggered at our level," Sleepy Winter said.

Twinkle Fried Rice and Rainy Kim agreed. They both felt that they had been involved in a difficult mission that exceeded their level. With their newbie level, they could only be bystanders.

The three of them did not know that the Germinal Organization and the Six Nations had a direct conflict three months after the open beta. At that time, the players had a basic understanding of the world structure and had some combat power. The conflict between the Six Nations and the Germinal Organization started on a small scale and gradually progressed, allowing the players to slowly participate and play a role.

However, Han Xiao had completely messed up the process and brought forward the direct conflict between the Six Nations and the Germinal Organization. Therefore, the current players did not have the ability to participate at all. Well, to be precise, the players had been tricked into missing the main storyline mission that they should have had.

This was more beneficial to Han Xiao than it was detrimental. It reduced the variables that the players brought in the early stages, making them only be bystanders.

…

Huff, huff, huff!

Two heavy-duty transport helicopters with the Fabian Organization's logo slowly landed in a valley. The wind created by the rotors blew, and the grass at the landing site shook in all directions like waves of grass.

"Old Black, we've arrived," the pilot, Antonio, said weakly.

"I have eyes. Also, don't call me Old Black anymore!"

Han Xiao said with dissatisfaction. "If you want to call me that, call me Black Phantom. You're ruining my luck."

Antonio took off his noise-canceling headphones and blew a puff of smoke at Han Xiao. "Come on, you don't even have that kind of thing."

"F * ck off," Han Xiao said with annoyance.

For the past two months, Han Xiao had maintained a good working relationship with the Fabian Organization. Antonio's relationship with the Fabian Organization had improved day by day. If this was some kind of indescribable game, it was now time to conquer it.

Looking at Roshan, who was hiding in the pilot's seat and adjusting the dashboard, Han Xiao hurriedly threw this scary thought out of his mind.

Mad Blade, Furious Sword, was hiding in the corner of the helicopter. He trembled as he watched the two 'extremely lethal' bosses talk and laugh. He thought that Han Xiao would drive to the location, but Han Xiao only made a phone call, and two helicopters came to pick them up. Han Xiao's image in his mind became even higher.

The Fabian Organization's personnel moved the supplies from the helicopters. Most of them were weapons and equipment that Han Xiao had stored in the Fabian Organization. They would be useful for this operation. There was also a dismantled truck. The Fabian Organization's maintenance workers reassembled it on the ground. Han Xiao and Antonio were chatting at the side.

Antonio had always thought that Han Xiao was only interested in the bounty, so he asked curiously, "I heard that Stardragon and Hesla are preparing to stop the Germinal Organization's retreat in Tedramira. Do you have a grudge against the Germinal Organization?"

"How do you know which side I'm on?" Han Xiao laughed.

Antonio held a cigar in one hand and put the other in his pocket. He frowned and said, "Are you thinking of helping the Germinal Organization?"

Although the Germinal Organization was a giant in the underground world, other forces kept a respectful distance from it. In the end, the underground world wanted to maintain order. A stable situation was the only way to make profits. In their eyes, the Germinal Organization was a group of thugs motivated by hatred and ideology.

Han Xiao did not comment. He walked to the side, took out his phone, and dialed another number. The voice of a person in charge of the Blood Pact Society came out of the phone.

"Mr. Black Phantom, how can I help you?"

Ever since he climbed to the top ten of the Assassin Ranking, the Blood Pact Society valued him very much and gave him special treatment. There was a person in charge of answering his call twenty-four hours a day and providing him with special services … well, proper special services.

Part of his status was due to his strength, and part of it was due to the good relationship between Han Xiao and Bennett, which was valued by the Dark Net.

"I need the latest movement of the Germinal Organization's retreat army and Stardragon and Hesla."

"Okay, I'm applying for access. It will be sent to your computer soon."

"Okay, I also need a helicopter to be on standby near the estuary of Tedramira River."

"As you wish."

Frenzied Sword, who was standing at the side, heard it loud and clear. Just by listening to the tone, he felt that Han Xiao was extremely awesome.

After hanging up the phone, Han Xiao saw Mad Blade and Furious Sword standing at the side with nothing to do. He thought for a while and sent a mission to them.

"You have triggered the mission [Get High]! Mission Requirement: Dance a hot dance to liven up the atmosphere. "

Mad Blade and Furious Sword burst into tears.
